title: Commuting equal exponent means
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $p>0$, and let $F:\{0,1\}^n\times\{0,1\}\to\mathbb R$. Taking uniform power means with exponent $p$ in each variable, the mean over $x\in\{0,1\}^n$ of the means over $y\in\{0,1\}$ equals the mean over $y\in\{0,1\}$ of the means over $x\in\{0,1\}^n$.
replaced: Let $p>0$ and $F:\{0,1\}^n\times\{0,1\}\to\bbr$. For uniform power means $M_{p,z}u=(\E_z|u|^p)^{1/p}$, one has $M_{p,x}(M_{p,b}F(x,b))=M_{p,b}(M_{p,x}F(x,b))$.
